bus.via: Burrard Skytrain Station to Squamish Adventure Center

trips.route_note: Take the BC Ferries connector or a direct coach from downtown Vancouver; the Sea to Sky Highway route runs straight to Squamish with no changes needed.
trips.why: A direct coach from downtown reaches Squamish in about an hour with no changes, dropping you near the sights.
know: Book the coach ahead in summer, when seats fill up
The Sea to Sky Highway views are best on clear days
Bring layers; weather changes quickly in the mountains
